decisions.statement: A stretch with an end runs from its start to that end.
A stretch with no end runs from its start to now.
A stretch with no end on an earlier day runs to the midnight ending that day.
A day whose date is unreadable counts a stretch with no end to now.
A stretch beginning after the instant it is counted to ran no hours.
A stretch whose start cannot be read is no reading rather than no hours.

definition: the hours a stretch ran, with one still running counted to now
